title: Laws, Bylaws, And Regulations Regarding Foreigners

page_data.en:
November 2 37.

Mrs. Paul D. Twinem,
Foreign Department,
Metropolitan Police Department,
Nanking.

Madam,

Laws, Bye-laws, etc.

In reply to your letter dated October 28, 1937,
the particulars asked for in regard to the above are
as follows :-

Laws.

Foreigners enjoying extraterritorial rights are
subject to the laws of the country to which they belong.
All other foreigners are subject to Chinese laws provided
such laws do not infringe upon the Land Regulations and
Bye-laws.

Bye-laws.

A copy of Municipal Bye-laws is attached.

Regulations.

A copy of Traffic Regulations is attached.

Both bye-laws and regulations are usually applied
by Governments enjoying extraterritorial rights in their
respective Courts.

I am,
Madam,
Your obedient servant,

Commissioner of Police.

（批：Enclosed 4/11）
（批：mB）
page_data.zh:
1937年11月2日。

保罗·D·特威内姆夫人，
外交部，
首都警察厅，
南京。

女士：

法律、附则等。

兹复贵方1937年10月28日来函，关于上述事项所询详情如下：

法律。

享有治外法权的外国人受其本国法律管辖。所有其他外国人受中国法律管辖，但以该等法律不侵犯《土地章程》及附则为限。

附则。

随函附上《工部局附则》副本一份。

规章。

随函附上《交通规章》副本一份。

上述附则及规章通常由享有治外法权的各国政府在其各自法院中适用。

此致，

警务处处长。

（批注：附件 11月4日）
（批注：mB）

首都警察廳
METROPOLITAN POLICE DEPARTMENT
NANKING. CHINA
8170

October 28, 1937

Dear Sir:

Will you please send us your laws, by-laws
and regulations regarding foreigners under your juris-
diction?    With appreciation, and thanking you
in advance, I am

Very sincerely
Mary Alice Twinem
(Mrs. Paul D. Twinem)
For the Foreign Dep't.

Major Gerrard, Commissioner
Police Headquarters
S. M. C., Shanghai

能否请贵处寄送有关贵方管辖下外国人的法律、附则及规章？不胜感激，并预先致谢。

此致
